statement: Cosmic balls from the winter event double an arcade bonus if it is already maxed with golden balls.
Maxing a single arcade upgrade takes about 32000 golden balls without the stamp that reduces golden ball cost.
S tier is top priority, A is worth considering, B is middling, C is mostly avoided, and F is a waste of 32000 balls.
Base damage is F tier and a complete waste of time; it is not strong.
Catching XP % is C tier; it is not very helpful in the later game.

subsystem: gold coin and lustre coin cash
statement: Both cash coin bonuses are B tier; they would be better with higher percentages.

subsystem: gold coin and lustre coin cash
statement: Put a couple of points into the coin bonuses early because money is hard to get in the early game.
Class XP % is trash and F tier; Grind Time and basic hats are better.
Shiny critter % becomes irrelevant by the time you reach it; C tier at most and close to F.
Trapping XP % is B tier; trapping XP is hard to get and very good.
Trapping levels are a punishment even with nature traps prayer of proficiency and transfusion so trapping XP is worth getting.
Starting tower defense points are very strong early for Frosty Firefight but fall off over the game; B tier.
Put a few points into starting tower defense points to get started in Tower Defense; it falls off quickly after.
Tab one talent points is S tier and god tier; you need it any time of year.
Creator says he would pay real money for these talent points, comparing them to autoloot-style value.
Weapon power is C tier almost F; it is mid-game style and was nerfed since World 3.
Weapon power is better than base damage; F and C tier picks are marginal could-or-couldn't choices.
Skill XP % is always really good and a priority; B tier just above tower defense starting points.
Skill XP is not as good as trapping XP but feeds into trapping.
Base defense % is F tier; FMJ ends up replacing it and it is nice only in early game.
Spending 32000 golden balls on base defense is poor when about five plat on a stamp gives the same; better than base damage but worse than weapon power.
Base strength agility and wisdom are A tier because base stats scale with all stat % and help money accuracy damage and skilling.
Base luck is B tier because it is less powerful than the other three base stats.
Trapping critter % is top of A tier; more critters are always needed.
Trapping critter % gives more critters without extra efficiency but does not scale up shinies.
Critters matter for Refinery scorpions and level 13 vials; top of A tier.
Worship soul % is S tier; the bottom of S and better than critters.
Worship soul % helps ignore a lot of Tower Defense in Frosty Firefight and helps get breezy souls in World 6 and prayers.
Refinery % speed is easy S tier with no competition; anything increasing salt production is massive.

numbers: Salt lick and refiner are rough so any extra refinery speed should be taken whenever possible.
statement: yes
Forge capacity is still important despite the hole bonus, because it scales and reduces two-minute claims and candy use.
Forge capacity is S tier and worth maxing and doubling; new worlds bars and level 13 God Shard and Dreadlo vials need more.
Drop rate % is the best stat in the game and should be the first one maxed.
Drop rate helps rare mob farming and multi-kill farming for base materials.
Cooking speed multi is multiplicative not additive and one of the strongest arcade bonuses per point spent.
Free-to-play players without No Meal Left Behind should treat it as heavy A; with NMLB it matters only around cooking level 70s.
Cooking speed multi is bottom A for most players; it drops to C once at 90 plates and F if no more plates come.
Total accuracy % is S or A tier; best early buy and still relevant late because of dog den and shimmer.
Stacking accuracy % with artifact dungeons percent early means you never have an accuracy problem and can run through worlds.
Creator thinks accuracy is higher than 3D printer power of 10 turkeys; argues accuracy matters until mid World 6.
Lab XP % is B tier next to trapping XP; lab XP is hard to scale since it comes from AFK gains.
You need 2100 account level for Lab to get the last jewels so lab XP is mildly useful late.
If you have maxed S and A tier and are working on B tier you are a whale because it takes huge golden balls or jackpots.
Breed pet damage % is C tier; useful for territory battles and 200 Arena then irrelevant.
Pet damage is available from Beast Master talents and cooking so it is placed below shiny critter % and catching XP.
Nugget regen % is top of C tier; with cosmic it gives about plus one nugget which is barely noticeable.
Nugget regen is more useful in later game than shiny and could improve with super bits page two or the final gaming unlockable.
Artifact find chance is flat additive not multiplicative, not very good, placed below catching XP and maybe below shiny.
Sailing loot % is additive and helps level boats; top of C, bottom of B, behind nugget regen in some takes.
Loot value and nugget regen belong in the same spot because neither is needed once boats are leveled or the nugget is complete.
White essence gain % is good because endless summoning never ends and white essence gives mana regen, placed right below accuracy.
Anything in A or S tier will not disappoint.
Jade gain % is bottom S or top A and fantastic; sneaking never ends so speeding it up is a big win.
Farming XP % is above trapping XP; farming levels add to sneaking and sneaking needs 120 trap.
Divinity XP % is another weak skill XP; placed behind lab XP because you do not need 2100 divinity level.
You can stop after Divinity one or two god ranks, with Bear God as the main reason for more levels.
Villager XP multi is multiplicative and unbelievably strong for the hole.
When he maxed villager XP his figure went from about 4.7 million to 6.8 million.
More caverns are guaranteed (about 15 or more) plus more villagers so villager XP will stay important.
Villager XP is below refinery speed and drop rate but above forge cap since forge cap is obtainable in the hole; should be second or third max.
Mining XP % is slightly better than catching XP but baseline mining XP flatlines everything so it is not needed.
Gold ball gain % is SS tier and should be maxed first because it halves the cost of every other investment.
Fishing XP % is placed above mining XP and argued to be the best of the three XP types.
Fishing XP is easy to get thanks to Equinox cheese and sea salt.
Sample size % is easy to get 90% without arcade points through printer, so it is a poor spend.
Sample size % is only useful if trying to drop the Royal Sampler prayer; that is an overly endgame standpoint.
AFK gain rate % is bottom of A tier; decent early but small given AFK gains can reach about 500%.
AFK gain is only 2% for 32000 balls, and a badly rolled keychain gives more.
Liquid cap bonus is C tier but better than everything else in C; other sources exist but it helps a bit.
Liquid cap bonus is placed in front of starting worship defense; either spot is fine.
Multi-kill per tier is not base multi-kill; with 53 damage tiers it gives 530 multi-kill at max cosmic, and it is always strong.
Multi-kill per tier is bottom S or top A; debate whether jade or souls goes above it.
Multi-kill per tier is the goat, useless early and mid game but strong late, and he says you do hit multikill when pushing worlds.
Placement varies by game stage; if you only did S tier you would be happy and S and A are all good.
B C and F tier may vary slightly depending on early mid late or end game.
